findings.title: Release the registry guard before awaiting keyed work
findings.comment: keylock.py:34-61 holds _guard while awaiting lock.acquire() and throughout yield. A live probe showed key B could not enter while key A was active, and B's 0.01s timeout still had not fired after 0.03s because it was waiting for _guard before reaching wait_for().

findings.title: Clear in-flight state when a factory fails
findings.comment: cache.py:130-133 removes and signals the event only after factory() and _store() succeed. After a factory raised, inflight() remained 1 and a retry never invoked its factory, confirming that retries and joiners wedge on the orphaned event.

findings.title: Check expiry before extending the deadline
findings.comment: cache.py:75-80 increments hits and replaces expires_at before testing the prior deadline. With ttl=1 and refresh_after_hits=3, two fresh hits followed by a read at time 2 returned the original value and left the factory call count at one, violating README's freshness contract.

findings.title: Apply cache timeouts to in-flight joins
findings.comment: cache.py:105-118 awaits pending.wait() before resolving either the per-call timeout or _lock_timeout. A joined call using timeout=0.01 was still pending after 0.03s behind a blocked producer.

findings.title: Update hit-rate consumers with the counter rename
findings.comment: cache.py produces cache.get.hit, cache.get.hit_after_wait, and cache.get.miss, while jobqueue.py:202-210 reads cache.hit, cache.hit_after_wait, and cache.miss. After a real miss the snapshot contained cache.get.miss=1, but cache_hit_rate() returned 1.0 and warm_stale_keys() refreshed zero candidates.

coverage.lens: Scrutinize failure and cancellation cleanup for per-key inflight computations. Ensure joiners wake and retries can proceed after a factory fails.
Verify that `KeyedLock` still permits concurrency across different keys. Check that its timeout covers the full wait.
Check sliding-expiry ordering so an access cannot renew an already expired cache entry.
Trace the renamed cache metrics through hit-rate and warm-up logic. Ensure every producer and consumer uses the same counter names.
